name: Funnel Chart
description: A framework-free Web Component that reads an HTML table and draws ordered stages as bars from a shared baseline, not as a trapezoid whose area exaggerates every drop. Both conversion rates are printed, the loss is drawn where it happened, and the largest drop is named.

variants.name: Default
variants.description: Ordered bars, both conversion rates, the loss drawn where it happened, and the largest drop marked.

variants.name: Shape
variants.description: Why a funnel is not a trapezoid, and the optional six-step ordinal shading for the familiar look.

variants.name: Rates
variants.description: Step-to-step against from-the-top, and the broken step that only one of them finds.

variants.name: Compare
variants.description: Two funnels side by side, and the pinned ceiling that makes them comparable rather than merely adjacent.

variants.name: Table
variants.description: The data contract, the no-script fallback, and why row order is never sorted.

variants.name: States
variants.description: A stage that grew, a single stage, a top of zero, refetching, and a failure.
